description: This file contains the implementation of the CalendarService class, which provides methods for synchronizing with the device's calendar, fetching events, and adding new events. It interacts with EventKit to read and write calendar data, handles authorization, and processes date formatting. The class conforms to the CalendarServicing protocol and is designed for managing calendar events within an iOS application.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: A service class providing calendar functionalities such as fetching and adding events, conforming to the CalendarServicing protocol.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified range, limits the number of results, and returns them formatted as payload objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new event to the calendar with specified parameters, handling authorization, validation, and selecting the appropriate calendar.

methods.name: resolveCalendar
methods.description: Resolves and returns a calendar either by identifier or title, or defaults to the default calendar, throwing an error if none found.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Resolves the start and end date range from ISO8601 strings, defaulting to the current date and a one-week span if not provided.
